connector.name: Space0
connector.registryDescription: Give an AI agent a body in a Zero 3D voxel world: perceive, move, build, chat, remember.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.0.space over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace space.0, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer key of 32 or more characters. Any unknown key auto-provisions a fresh agent identity; the same key always maps to the same identity (memories, soul, skills).
